findings.title: Container runs out of memory
findings.cause: container indexer is killed for memory (OOMKilled) under the pod's own 64Mi memory limit (spec.resources.limits.memory): it sets no limit of its own, and that limit is shared by all 2 of the pod's containers; Deployment indexer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container indexer exited with code 137 (OOMKilled), restarted 7 times
the pod has memory limit 64Mi, and container indexer has none
evidence.command: kubectl get pod indexer-695d56ddf9-8bfxg -n kd-oom-pod-level-limit -o jsonpath='{.spec.resources}{" "}{.spec.containers[?(@.name=="indexer")].resources}'

findings.fix: Raise the pod-level memory limit (spec.resources.limits.memory, now 64Mi) to what all the pod's containers use together at peak, or give indexer a limit of its own inside it so that one container's growth is told apart.
